title: The README's console sample reports a ledger 56 times the size of this one
foundBy: session agent, following README.md and INSTALL.md as a first-time reader
details:
The quickstart introduces its sample with "Here they are against this repository's own ledger" and shows:

```
wrote ledger/ledger.html (195856 bytes, 56 issues, 0 drafts)
check OK: 56 issues, 0 drafts, 0 warning(s), ledger.html fresh
```

This repository's ledger held one record, so the real output was `(78029 bytes, 1 issues, 0 drafts)`. The launch reduction moved the corpus and the sample stayed behind.

A reader who follows the link two sections above lands on the rendered page and counts the records themselves, so the contradiction is one click away.

The number tracks a live corpus and will drift again. Either quote what this ledger prints today and accept that, or move the sample onto the frozen fixture under fixtures/.
